    # Calculate the horizontal distance needed to reach the x-coordinate of the flag

    # Calculate the vertical distance needed to reach the y-coordinate of the flag

def min_path_length(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    # Calculate the minimum distance to move the quadcopter to the flag
    horizontal_move = abs(x1 - x2)
    vertical_move = abs(y1 - y2)
    
    # Total moves to reach the flag
    total_moves_to_flag = horizontal_move + vertical_move
    
    # To form a loop around the flag, we need to add twice the maximum of horizontal and vertical moves
    # This ensures the quadcopter covers all sides of the rectangle formed by the starting point, flag, and the final point
    return total_moves_to_flag * 2
